body:
1. Book a time: on your phone (any time, for open hours) or with Nurse Penny at the lobby desk (while open). Only sick pets can be booked.
2. Your time is a 2-hour window (about 1.5 real minutes). Nobody booked: walk right in.
3. Come with the sick pet following you. Early: wait in the lobby. Late: book again, no coins lost.
4. Go into the cabinet. Dr. Rūta checks the pet.
5. Nurse Leo has a short talk and gives the pet a treat. The pet is cured; its mood is normal. Your care makes it happy.
6. Leo reminds you: don't let it get sad, always look after its needs.
7. One visit treats every sick pet following you. Pay per pet; free if you can't pay. Hours and price: Schedules and economy chat.
8. All pets fit, bear and seal come in too. Farm animals never visit. Friends there see it.
9. No vet job for players for now.
